formulation.evidence: The Postulate defines the normalized positive periodic filter, the exact filtered covariance, the symmetric rate matrix, the 3D model tensor 2kI_3/3 - 2nu_t D, and its modeled transfer with units. Step 3a explicitly uses the space-first ordered domain T_L^3 x I for pressure and model fields and defines q(x,t)=(q(t))(x) for time-indexed spatial fields; tensor products are now well typed.

scope.evidence: The Statement is limited to the smooth periodic 3D incompressible Newtonian model and treats k and nu_t as prescribed nonnegative model fields. It explicitly disclaims exact-covariance equality, positive-semidefiniteness of the modeled tensor, empirical adequacy in every regime, and universal no-backscatter.

sources.evidence: Washington ME 544 §§3–5, Gibbs LES Lecture 12 pp. 7–8 and 17–24, and MIT OCW 12.820 Chapter 3 §§3.6–3.8 were inspected at the recorded locators. The first two independently support the LES stress sign and eddy-viscosity model; MIT supports the distinction between added closure assumptions and deductions.

non_derivation.evidence: This is an adopted postulate with proof not-applicable. The text says the closure is not derived from the Newtonian equations and does not assert exact-covariance equality or physical validation.
